#123 fixes rejected admission state loss; it does not introduce transactional persistence for successful channel deliveries. Existing successful queueUpdate save semantics remain outside this report.

#126 text budget added after initial commit as followup in shared#127 commit, because node counts alone do not bound repeated large label memory. Normal repeated blocks are allowed; only current recursion path is a cycle.

#127 central metadata is bounded before JSZip allocation; actual stream counters reject lying values. Only the public pause API is used. Current pinned inflater input chunk can finish decoding after rejection, but further compressed chunks stop and later decoded output is ignored. No async()/accumulate() preflight buffering or vendor modification.

DOCX gate is ZIP/input/expansion validation, not a promise of bounded OOXML layout, XML semantics or image pixels. UnsupportedZIP/multivolume/encryption/version changes fail closed with download guidance. Limits do not alter raw files, upload/download protocols or plugin-provided preview implementations.

Browser verification is actual-source component with generated local fixtures and real libraries, not a full start.command workbench, native CAD/Word/WPS, SSH/device or production acceptance. No real user files, paid model, merge, release or deployment. Existing platform/full-gate blockers persist.
